parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Coefficients: $\binom71 2^6ax$ and $\binom72 2^5a^2x^2$ — B1 B1

May be seen as part of the expansion.

$7\cdot2^6a=21\cdot2^5a^2$, so $a=\frac23$ — B1

Ignore extra solution $a=0$.

SOI. Can be part of the expansion. Condone $ax^2$ only if followed by $a^2$. Ignore extra solution $a=0$; allow $a=0.667$. Do not allow an extra $x$ in the answer.

[3]
